title: YourTRIBE secures £47m refinance for Elephant & Castle PBSA
summary:
Investec Bank has provided a £46.95m senior investment loan to purpose-built student accommodation operator YourTRIBE for its 226-bed scheme in Elephant & Castle. The facility refinances the existing lender and marks Investec's second completed deal with the group.

title: Three property firms announce senior appointments
summary:
Three property sector businesses have announced senior appointments as they expand operations and strengthen management teams across England. Hockeys Estate Agents has promoted two staff to director level, Spicerhaart has created its first marketing director role, and Gleeson Homes has appointed a commercial director for its North West region.

title: Estate agents lag behind consumer expectations on trust
summary:
A substantial gap has emerged between what estate agents promote and what consumers value when selecting an agency, according to new research examining professionalism standards in the property sector. The report found that 74% of agents believe formal qualifications should be required to operate in estate and lettings agency, with 75% of consumers in agreement.

title: Savills downgrades UK house price forecast to 18.5% by 2030
summary:
Savills has revised its UK housing market forecast downwards, now projecting mainstream house prices will decline by 2% in 2026 as elevated mortgage costs continue to suppress buyer demand and affordability. The property consultancy has lowered its five-year outlook, expecting mainstream UK house prices to rise by 18.5% by 2030, down from a previous forecast of 22.2%.

title: UK property transactions fall 3% in April amid uncertainty
summary:
UK property transactions declined by 3% between March and April 2026 according to HMRC data, as the housing market contended with global economic uncertainty. Seasonally adjusted figures show transactions fell from 103,910 in March to 101,030 in April, though year-on-year comparisons remain distorted by previous Stamp Duty changes.

title: Gravesham Council advances HMO planning controls
summary:
Gravesham Council in Kent is progressing with plans to introduce an Article 4 Direction requiring planning permission for smaller HMOs. The regulatory change follows a local campaign backed by residents concerned about shared housing concentration.

title: EXP reaches 1,000 agents as self-employed model grows
summary:
Self-employed agency platform EXP has reached 1,000 member agents in the UK, representing approximately half of the estimated 2,000 self-employed estate agents operating in Britain. Data shows the company became Britain's largest estate agency brand by new instructions in June 2025.

title: £950k bridging loan funds £2.7m Menai Strait development
summary:
A two-property development on Beach Road overlooking the Menai Strait in Wales has achieved a gross development value of £2.7 million following £950,000 in development funding from Charles Street. Developer Gary Poole of Lingar Holdings (Chester) Limited purchased the site in July 2021 for £535,000 with planning permission subsequently granted for two dwellings.

title: Canterbury commercial property secures £1.5m bridging loan
summary:
Recognise Bank has provided a £1.5 million bridging loan for the acquisition of a multi-building commercial property in Canterbury, Kent. The 15-month facility supports plans to convert upper floors to residential use whilst improving the commercial tenant mix.

The post Canterbury commercial property secures £1.5m bridging loan appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Cambridge medtech scheme secures £3.6m refurbishment funding
summary:
A £3.6 million refurbishment facility has been arranged to convert an existing commercial building in South Cambridgeshire into medical technology and office space. The financing will support the redevelopment of approximately 20,000 sq ft targeting the region's innovation sector.
